overall_reason: One terracotta hue fills everything: the #da805b stage, the #ecac84 invoice, the #e29b7c deposit card and every text element in #813d31 or #a96754, so ground, surface, ink and the 'Paid' state are the same colour.

score.reason: T-ACCENT-DOSAGE finds a page-scale band in the accent with no neutral surface for content, T-SURFACE-LADDER finds the raised card darker than the card below it, and T-PALETTE-ROLES finds the state in the same hue as the ink.

findings.title: Colour follows one posture
findings.evidence: The palette table lists page-scale fills in hue 43: #da805b at 540 by 420px and #ecac84 at 350 by 400px; chromatic area is 5.5% at 1440 and 14.3% at 375, and the hue colours 14 text elements. The sweep's accent_footprint reports 5.7% of the fold (CLR-001).
findings.before: Terracotta as ground, card surface, ink and state
findings.after: One posture: a neutral or lightly tinted paper for the content surfaces, with the terracotta held to the stage or to one accent role
findings.why: When one hue is every role, the content has no neutral surface to rest on and the accent marks nothing.

findings.title: Depth comes from lightness and one shadow
findings.where: deposit card over the invoice, 1440, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P38\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png and C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P38\03-lenses\color\gray-fold-1440.png
findings.evidence: The front deposit card fills with #e29b7c, darker than the #ecac84 invoice it overlaps; in the grayscale fold the raised card is the darker of the two.
findings.before: Raised card #e29b7c on a lighter #ecac84 card
findings.after: Raised surfaces one step lighter than what they sit on
findings.why: A raised surface that is darker reads as a hole, so the layering contradicts the shadow.

findings.title: State colours keep their meaning
findings.evidence: The 'Paid' label is #a3433c, in the same red-orange band as the ink #813d31 and the fills; no other hue marks the state.
findings.before: State text in the accent hue
findings.after: A state colour outside the accent hue, or the state shown by an icon and label in ink
findings.why: When the state shares the hue of every other element, colour stops signalling that the invoice is paid.

strengths: Text on the terracotta uses darker shades of the same hue rather than grey (CLR-011 kept).
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
